design_context.theme_preference: System Default / Light & Dark Toggle supported with restrained high-contrast financial palette

layout_and_spacing.container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 space-y-8

header.description: Sticky top bar with glassmorphism blur (backdrop-blur-md bg-background/80), showing brand logo 'Invoice-to-Decision Agent', session reset, mode switcher, and live backend connection state indicator.

sample_presets_selector.description: Interactive card offering 6 quick test invoices matching all test criteria (Happy Path, Split PO Invoice 1, Split PO Invoice 2, Over-tolerance, Scanned/OCR, Missing Data, Duplicate). Allows 1-click execution.

pdf_uploader.description: Drag-and-drop PDF dropzone with file preview, size check, sample pre-fill trigger, and instant submission button.

live_pipeline_stage_tracker.description: 3-Stage Animated Stepper showing sequential processing (Stage 1: Extraction -> Stage 2: PO Matching -> Stage 3: Validation & Decision). Features active scanning ripples, step duration timers, and status badges.

extraction_details_card.description: Displays extracted key-value pairs (vendor_name, invoice_number, invoice_date, po_reference, total_amount) and extraction method badge (Direct Text Layer vs Local OCR Fallback).

po_matching_card.description: Displays direct PO lookup match or Fallback match (Vendor Name + 5% amount range). Highlights matched PO details: PO Number, Vendor, PO Amount, Tolerance %, and Current Billed Status.

decision_card.description: Hero result banner showcasing Decision Badge (APPROVE, FLAG, REJECT, PENDING), clear Human-Readable Explanation, exact validation rule triggered, and cumulative split-PO progress bar.

po_database_modal_table.description: Accessible tab or drawer showing seeded PO Dataset (6 POs) with cumulative amounts, vendor details, and status so users can cross-verify PO matching logic.

session_history_dashboard.description: Summary KPI metric cards (Total Invoices Processed, Approved, Flagged, Rejected, Pending) and full audit history table with sortable columns, search filter, and row details drawer.

stage_sequence.name: PDF Text & Image Extraction
stage_sequence.description: Extracting fields via PyPDF/pdfplumber or OCR fallback engine...

stage_sequence.name: PO Database Match
stage_sequence.description: Querying PO reference or searching vendor + 5% amount tolerance matrix...

stage_sequence.name: Validation Rule Cascade & Cumulative Check
stage_sequence.description: Checking missing fields, duplicates, cumulative split-PO limits, and tolerances...

image_urls.description: Hands sorting invoices and documents on an office desk, showcasing operational invoice review
Analytical finance desk with calculator, charts, and binders

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure ALL interactive elements (buttons, dropzone, table rows, filter tabs, modal toggles) have strict data-testid attributes.
Implement sequential live-run stage execution with visible micro-delays (e.g., 600-800ms between stages) so users see Extraction -> Matching -> Decision unfolding live.
Make sure the cumulative split-PO tracking clearly shows how multiple invoices against the same PO build up total billed amount.
Show the Extraction Method Badge clearly: 'Text Layer (PDF Direct)' in neutral dark badge vs 'OCR Fallback (Scanned PDF)' in amber/purple tactile badge.
Include sample buttons pre-seeded with all 6 required scenario files so the reviewer can run the entire test suite in seconds without uploading manual PDFs.
Do not use transparent dropdown/popover backgrounds; use solid or high-opacity backdrop-blur panels.
Use Javascript (.jsx / .js) files matching the repository stack.
